basics.name: Sreehari P V
basics.summary: Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience building scalable web and mobile applications across the React.js, Next.js, and React Native ecosystem. Experienced in developing production-grade applications, enterprise mobile solutions, and AI-driven automation systems. Strong background in TypeScript, modern state management (Redux, React Query, Context API), backend systems using Node.js and NestJS, and performance optimization.

highlights: Built a configurable theming engine that lets Shopify merchants convert their storefronts into fully functional native mobile apps.
Worked on enterprise React Native apps for global brands — push notifications, analytics, secure auth flows (NDA).
Cut re-render cycles through memoization and lazy loading across core app modules.
Deepened understanding of RN internals: navigation stacks, rendering cycles, and cross-platform quirks.
Managed mobile CI/CD and App Store / Play Store release workflows via GitHub Actions.
Worked with GitHub Actions and mobile deployment workflows for CI/CD and release management.
Won 1st place at an internal hackathon — built an AI-powered content refresh system that improved SEO rankings by 35%.
Built a Redis + Sentence Similarity caching layer that cut API response times by 40%.
Led the React Native Service Provider app from scratch to production deployment.
Built a multilingual product classification system using LLMs and a dynamic SEO module from web-scraped data.
Designed a real-time reporting system using Apache Superset.
Optimized React web app performance through lazy loading, code splitting, and efficient state management.
